people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
translations.bsb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
translations.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
translations.asv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
